caption_zh: 同一自身观测下的全局方向自由度。（a）相同IMU与足端接触数据、七种已知初始航向产生相互旋转的轨迹，突出0°与±100°；起点箭头表示已知初始Euler航向，不由轨迹切线推断。星号为共同起点，圆点为终点。（b）仅消除每次运行已知的初始绕z轴旋转后，七条相对路径重合；无尺度、平移、时间或拟合航向对齐。（c）同一时刻与0°运行相比的三维位置差，纵轴以10⁻⁷ m为单位，所有原生历元保留。最大差约1.9×10⁻⁷ m，解释了（b）曲线在图面上重合的原因。两张主面板使用相同、等比例的任意局部坐标；它们不是地理真值误差。完整接触窗口秩谱和四维全局自由度结果随图保留。
caption_en: Global heading freedom under identical proprioceptive observations. (a) Seven runs of the same IMU and foot-contact inputs, initialized with different known yaw angles, produce globally rotated trajectories. The 0° and ±100° cases are highlighted; arrows show the known initial Euler-yaw directions, not the trajectory tangents. The star is the common start and dots are endpoints. (b) Removing only the known initial rotation makes all seven relative paths coincide; no fitted yaw, scale, translation or time alignment is applied. (c) Three-dimensional position differences relative to the 0° run at identical native epochs, expressed in units of 10⁻⁷ m. The maximum discrepancy is about 1.9×10⁻⁷ m. Both main panels use the same equal-scale arbitrary local coordinates; these differences are not errors against geographic ground truth. Full structural spectra and rank results accompany the figure.
alignment: p_aligned = Rz(-known_initial_yaw) p; native timestamps identical; no fit or translation
arrow_definition: Body +x projection from known initial conventional Euler yaw; x=cos(yaw), y=sin(yaw); first native yaw values verified in summary
